summary: Enhance your skills with our Data Warehousing Fundamentals Training Course. Learn essential concepts and techniques to manage and analyze data effectively.
lede: Data warehousing organizes data from multiple sources into analytical structures for reporting and business insight. This training is for data warehouse architects, ETL developers, business intelligence analysts and data engineers who build or support reliable analytical data environments. Topics include dimensional modeling, ETL and ELT design, data profiling, slowly changing dimensions and OLAP presentation.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for technical professionals and decision-makers who are responsible for the lifecycle of analytical data within their organizations.
modules: Cloud Data Warehousing and Modern Stacks
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of Relational Database Management Systems (RDBMS) and basic proficiency in SQL. Familiarity with general business reporting requirements and data analysis concepts is recommended. No prior experience with specific data warehousing tools is required, as the course focuses on platform-agnostic methodologies.
topics: Statistics & data analysis (SPSS, Stata, R, Python)
